verdict.rationale: Lever's Automation Hub (docs-12, docs-22) automates routine actions like archiving, tagging, emailing, and advancing candidates, and webhooks/event configuration (docs-18, docs-33) allow event-driven triggers into external systems — showing rule/event-based automation exists. However, this is recruiting-workflow automation configured within Lever's UI/webhook system, not a general-purpose 'define custom rules for any event' engine aimed at AI-native/developer users. Missing for 10: documentation of a user-facing rule-builder/condition-action UI, evidence of custom trigger logic beyond preset automations, and confirmation that webhook events can be used to define arbitrary automated actions rather than just notify external systems.
